verdict.rationale: GoDaddy clearly ships versioned APIs: separate Domains v1, v2 and v3 OpenAPI specs, a v3 check-availability endpoint, a v2 forwarding API, and PATs required for v3 Domains APIs. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a version-migration process. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and migration guidance, deprecation headers or changelog, and independent corroboration.
